description_en: Calls the CreateSLB operation to attach a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance to a specified ApsaraDB for ClickHouse Community-Compatible Edition cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateSLB接口为指定云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群挂载SLB
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-slb --db-cluster-id cc-uf6bnitmve5n00000 --product clickhouse --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSLB

parameters.description_en: The cluster ID. Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~170879~~) operation to obtain the cluster ID.
parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id
